description: This file is an HTML document serving as the front-end UI for a database viewer application. It contains markup, styles, and embedded JavaScript that manages database connections, table data fetching, and dynamic rendering of table contents.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and populates the sidebar with database entries.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets current selections, and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles the expansion and collapsing of database entries to show or hide their tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches the list of tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads data for a selected table and renders it in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings with expandable features.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncate it.
